name: coolify
description: Cursor plugin for Coolify's built-in Streamable HTTP MCP. Browse servers, projects, apps, databases, and deployments on your Coolify instance — bring your own base URL and team-scoped API token.

COOLIFY_BASE_URL.title: Coolify base URL
COOLIFY_BASE_URL.description: Your Coolify instance origin with no trailing slash, e.g. https://app.coolify.io or https://coolify.example.com

COOLIFY_API_TOKEN.title: Coolify API token
COOLIFY_API_TOKEN.description: Team-scoped API token (Keys & Tokens). Needs at least read; add deploy only if you want lifecycle tools. Never commit this value.
